sentences.en: Meanwhile, the foolish uncle was sitting in the living room.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，愚蠢的叔叔正坐在客厅里。

sentences.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
sentences.zh: 那边读报纸的那个男人是我的叔叔。

sentences.en: Uncle Bob fixed my clock. It keeps good time now.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃叔叔修好了我的钟。现在它走得很准了。
